licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These 13 buckets reflect the principal clusters visible across all states: fraud in licensure/practice, criminal history, clinical quality failures, substance impairment, physical/mental disability, broad ethics/conduct, unlicensed-practice facilitation, advertising deception, billing/fee-splitting misconduct, controlled-substance prescribing misuse, record and reporting obligations, compliance with statutes/board orders, and reciprocal recognition of other-jurisdiction discipline—together covering the full distribution without leaving a large residual.

profession_specific.sedation_anesthesia_.rationale: These buckets follow the standard sedation depth continuum (minimal → moderate → deep → general anesthesia) plus the distinct modalities of nitrous oxide/inhalation analgesia and local anesthesia that appear frequently as separate permit types, with facility-level permits and miscellaneous specialty items (mobile services, radiology, cosmetic surgery, non-dental hospital anesthesia) captured in the remaining two buckets.
